description: Measures how the page reacts to an event: sends the steps, then watches the next frames for camera shake, scale pops, eased motion versus teleports, colour flashes, spawned particles, HUD text ticks and sounds. Use it on every event the user's feel brief names (hits, clears, explosions, pickups, deaths, wins) to check they feel like something, and to confirm nothing teleports.

frames.description: Frames to watch after the steps (default 45).

steps.description: Steps as for game_act, the inputs that cause the event.

name: game_feel
